scenarios.name: should recognize type-resolved arrays
scenarios.given: array, tuple, nullable union, or constrained generic receivers
scenarios.then: array and tuple members are recognized

scenarios.name: should allow unrelated methods
scenarios.given: a custom object with a method named push or sort

scenarios.name: should use conservative syntax fallback
scenarios.given: an array literal or stable alias with no TypeScript services
scenarios.then: only known array literals are recognized; unknown and reassigned bindings are skipped

scenarios.name: should recognize derived arrays
scenarios.given: array intersections and direct, indirect, generic, or interface-derived array types
scenarios.when: type resolution traverses constituents and base declarations with cycle protection
scenarios.then: array mutations are recognized without flagging unrelated classes or intersections
